success_patterns: Break compound requests into distinct deliverables and use the endpoint that directly provides each one.
Carry explicitly requested constraints—such as result counts, source, locale, and entity scope—into the corresponding schema fields.
Use the schema’s canonical parameter names and values while preserving the required response format.

patch.reasoning: These patterns are already covered by the skill. Two trajectories do, however, expose a recurring omission: an explicitly named search basis or government level can be missed when it has a dedicated optional selector. Making those selector types more salient reinforces the existing argument-building rule without adding a new section.

edits.target: including optional qualifiers such as location or area, active status, locale, sort, postal code, duration, quantity, source, or output mode;
edits.content: including optional qualifiers such as location or area, active status, locale, sort, postal code, duration, quantity, source, output mode, an explicitly named search or matching basis (even if it is the endpoint default), or a requested government or organizational level;
